documents.title: Orion availability
documents.text: Orion API uptime commitment is 99.95 percent per calendar month.

documents.title: Orion billing
documents.text: Orion API input processing costs USD 2.50 per million tokens. Orion archive storage costs USD 0.08 per gigabyte.

documents.title: Orion retention
documents.text: Orion account exports are retained for thirty days after closure.

documents.title: Orion client software
documents.text: Orion Python SDK version 2.7.1 is installed. The Orion runtime uses Python 3.12.

documents.title: Orion gateway
documents.text: Orion gateway allows 120 requests per minute. The client retries three times before reporting failure.

documents.title: Orion operational procedures
documents.text: To investigate Orion outages, correlate trace identifiers with deployment changes. To control token costs, trim context and record measured usage.

documents.title: Engineering training workshop
documents.text: The training workshop lasts two hours and costs USD 80. The event registration service reports 98 percent attendance. It has no Orion account policies.
